title: Project 1: Food Processing and Price
description: A bar chart comparing the median price per 100 calories across the four NOVA food processing classes. Ultra-processed foods cost about 45% less per calorie ($0.53 vs $0.97) than minimally processed foods.

title: Project 2: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: A group project using NYC CCRB complaint data. We made one chart for and one against the claim that naming more officers raises the chance a complaint is substantiated, then scored our own design choices.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: My portfolio site built across the DSC 106 labs with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It has a JS-built nav, a dark mode switcher, projects loaded from JSON, and GitHub stats pulled from the API.

title: COGS 108 Group Project
description: A quarter-long group data science project that is just getting started. Our team is building an NBA-themed analysis with a scholarly angle, and the research question is still being chosen.
